body:
Root cause found by direct investigation across every real hot-path candidate (voxel scan, RayTrace, IDUNA calls) -- the one real steady-state bottleneck was the world PacketSnapshot broadcast rate, capped at 4Hz purely because it shared its cadence with the main loop's blocking UDP read-timeout, already self-documented as a deferred follow-up never actually done. Raised both the read-timeout and snapshotInterval to 33ms/30Hz, matching SHANKPIT sibling's own rate. Zero concurrency changes -- clients/clientAddrs stay single-thread-owned exactly as before. Drive-by: removed a dead unused sync.RWMutex placeholder go vet was flagging. go build ./... clean across the whole repo, go vet clean, go test ./apps2/server-go/... all 23 tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-994001: core game loop performance tuning -- world snapshot broadcast raised 4Hz to 30Hz
